'''Hayashi Shrine''' (林神社, also read as Rin Shrine) refers to multiple Shinto shrines in Japan.

* {{ill|Hayashi Shrine (Tonami)|ja|林神社 (砺波市頼成)}} - Located in Tonami City, Toyama Prefecture.
* {{ill|Hayashi Shrine (Akashi)|ja|林神社 (明石市)}} - Located in Akashi City, Hyōgo Prefecture.
* Hayashi Shrine (Nara) - A subsidiary shrine within {{ill|Kangō Shrine|ja|漢國神社}} in Nara City, Nara Prefecture.
